verdict_reason: req-594 and req-595 now correctly require eight-a-page paging and the restored inset in line with the ticket, but req-594 cites a transporter-list precedent that does not exist yet and both rows keep delta notes written for the old one-page statements.

todos.issue: req-594's why says eight a page is what 'the transporter list already serve[s] over the same records'. It does not: the animals transporter list (features/transport/transporters/transporters.njk) renders no pagination, and EUDPA-824, the ticket to split it into pages of 8, is still To Do. The same claim is in ruling-ian-2026-11-23.md:27 ('Eight is the figure the INS address book list and the transporter list already use') and the inc-087 note in themes/consignment-parties/backlog.json, so a re-distil would carry a false precedent.
todos.fix: Must: req-594's why, the ruling and the inc-087 note cite only precedents that hold today: the INS address book list (req-1141) pages at eight, and the transporter list is at most the planned EUDPA-824 change. One way: reword to 'the INS address book list (req-1141) serves eight a page over the same records, and the transporter list is to page at eight too'.

todos.fix: Must: each of req-594 and req-595 has a delta and deltaNote that agree with its new statement and describe the code the requirement changes from. One way: rewrite both deltaNotes to say inc-087 left the pickers on one page with no inset (citing that, rather than the pre-inc-087 five-a-page claims as 'today'), and keep delta 'change' on both.
